title: Fix Node.js subprocess pipe buffer hang — drain stdout/stderr
description: P0 from 10-agent audit (escalated by council). MinecraftAdapter.StartNodeProcessAsync sets RedirectStandardOutput=true and RedirectStandardError=true but has no background read loop. When pipe buffers fill (4KB Windows, 64KB Linux), the Node.js process blocks on write(2) indefinitely. Bot becomes completely unresponsive. Fix: add background ReadToEndAsync tasks or set RedirectStandardOutput=false. Source: codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council-post-wave-c.md (P0-004).
